According to the information provided in the data tables and conversation logs up to the specified date, the reason people cannot sit on the newly installed benches at the community garden project is due to the paint still being wet. Turalyon, one of the project coordinators, shared this update with the community on June 4, 2026. The post emphasized the importance of allowing the paint to dry completely to maintain the aesthetic appearance of the benches. LiHua, along with others, expressed anticipation and excitement for being able to eventually use the benches once they are ready, but they understood and agreed to wait to maintain the quality and visual appeal of the installation.

In addition to the drying paint, community discussions also highlighted the ideas for enhancing the benches' area and ensuring the space is kid-friendly, welcoming, and engaging for all members. This included suggestions for decorative elements such as plants, lights, and themed flower arrangements. The collaborative spirit among the community members, as seen through these conversations, indicates a shared enthusiasm for creating a beautiful and functional communal space that everyone will appreciate.

As the project progresses, further ideas such as adding outdoor games, water features, picnic tables, and a garden area where children can participate in planting are being explored to enrich the garden space. The community's active participation in planning and providing input reflects an overall positive and proactive approach towards the development of the garden, ensuring that it will eventually become a cherished gathering spot for all residents.

This detailed summary captures both the immediate concern about the paint drying on the benches and the broader, constructive planning taking place within the community to transform the garden into an inviting area that caters to the collective interests and needs of the community members.
